data.one_liner: An extended text editing controller supporting different inline styles for custom regex patterns.
data.what_it_does: Extends Flutter's text editing controller to allow dynamic inline text styling using custom regular expression patterns. It provides interactive callbacks for matched text, IME composition support, and performance optimizations via regex caching.
use_when: You need to highlight specific patterns like hashtags or mentions inside a TextField.
You want custom inline styling and tap actions for text matching regex rules.
avoid_when: You are just displaying static rich text without text editing capabilities.
You need a full-featured markdown or rich text editor component rather than basic regex highlighting.
strengths: Interactive callbacks for user interaction with matched text
IME composition support for languages like Japanese and Chinese
weaknesses: Limited to regex-based inline styling within a text input controller
Not a complete WYSIWYG or markdown editor suite
